Opening night presents the Canadian premiere of the 4K restoration of Patrick TAM’s Love Massacre, starring Brigitte LIN. The festival closes with the North American premiere of CHONG Keat Aun’s Golden Horse Award-winning Mother Bhumi, winner of Best Leading Actress for FAN Bingbing, Best Cinematography and Best Original Film Song.
Discover six features and nine shorts from emerging filmmakers in the Fountainhead competition programme, and vote for your favourites. Other highlights include the world premiere of the new 4K restoration of Clara LAW’s Farewell, China, starring Maggie CHEUNG and Tony LEUNG Ka-Fai, and On Canvas, On Stage, a complete retrospective of QIU Jiongjiong’s films, including A New Old Play and Madame.

item.title: Book Launch: That Directionless Light of the Future, Rediscovering Russell FitzGerald — Thu Nov 26, 5:00 PM — Art Metropole
item.description:
Please join us for a book launch of That Directionless Light of the Future: Rediscovering Russell FitzGerald with editor Jon Davies. Stop by to pick up a copy of the publication and enjoy refreshments and a drop-in signing with the editor. Join us for brief remarks at 6pm. That Directionless Light of the Future: Rediscovering Russell FitzGerald is the first major publication devoted to artist Russell FitzGerald. Bringing together newly commissioned scholarship and more than 90 reproductions of paintings, drawings, illustrations, archival material the book offers the first comprehensive account of an artist whose ambitious vision has remained hidden for decades. Edited by Canadian art historian and curator Jon Davies, this handsome volume brings together reproductions of the artist’s work and other material with new texts by Davies, Dodie Bellamy, and Jamie Parra to return FitzGerald to art history and consider his relevance to the present.

In Buenos Aires, crooked small-time gambler Johnny Farrell (Glenn Ford) talks his way into an uneasy partnership with casino owner Ballin Mundson (George Macready).
